chat.title: Assistant

chat.fixPromptPrefill:
The generation of node “{{label}}” failed with: {{error}}
Analyze this node's prompt, fix it to avoid that error while staying true to the intent, update the node, then relaunch the generation.
chat.adjustPromptPrefill:
The output of node “{{label}}” doesn't work for me: 

Improve the prompt accordingly, update the node, then relaunch the generation.
chat.qcFixPrefill:
Vision QC on node “{{label}}” reports: {{notes}}
Look at the generation, analyse the prompt and propose a fix (then re-run once I approve).
chat.planApproveMessage: I approve the plan — go ahead.
chat.planChangesPrefill: I'd like to change the plan:

errors.title: Something broke

shotboard.name: Shot board
shotboard.desc: 4-panel grid of ONE shot — opening frame, action, closing frame
shotboard.placeholder: e.g. Maya threads between two vans, moving left to right

storyboard.name: Storyboard
storyboard.desc: 9-panel grid of the scene — preview the staging before generating video
storyboard.placeholder: e.g. Léa crosses the rooftop and leaps at sunset

expressions.name: Expression sheet
expressions.desc: A 6-panel grid — the same character, one emotion per panel

wardrobe.desc: The same character in several outfits — built from an approved sheet

packshot.name: Product pack-shot
packshot.desc: The hero product image — built from the client's own photo

shot-establishing.name: Establishing shot
shot-establishing.desc: Opens the scene: wide frame, slow move, the location reads before the action
shot-establishing.placeholder: e.g. the harbour at dawn, a figure on the quay

shot-tracking.name: Tracking shot
shot-tracking.desc: The camera travels alongside the subject at its own speed
shot-tracking.placeholder: e.g. Maya weaves between two vans

shot-push-in.name: Push-in
shot-push-in.desc: A slow dolly toward the subject — raise intensity without a cut
shot-push-in.placeholder: e.g. Léa's face as she understands

shot-pull-back.name: Pull-back reveal
shot-pull-back.desc: Starts tight and pulls back to disclose the context
shot-pull-back.placeholder: e.g. the hand on the handle, then the empty hall

shot-orbit.name: Orbit
shot-orbit.desc: The camera arcs around the subject — the product and hero shot
shot-orbit.placeholder: e.g. the headphones on their stand

shot-insert.name: Insert / macro detail
shot-insert.desc: A very short detail shot — the cutaway that lets an edit breathe

shot-reaction.name: Reaction close-up
shot-reaction.desc: Near-static frame carried entirely by the performance
shot-reaction.placeholder: e.g. Léa takes the news without a word

shot-pov-handheld.name: POV / handheld
shot-pov-handheld.desc: Subjective, unstable framing — presence and urgency
shot-pov-handheld.placeholder: e.g. the run down the corridor, short of breath

shot-whip-pan.name: Whip-pan transition
shot-whip-pan.desc: A fast pan that blurs out — cut it against the next shot's whip in
shot-whip-pan.placeholder: e.g. whip from the quay to the city

shot-locked-off.name: Locked-off frame
shot-locked-off.desc: A rigid frame where only the subject moves — the most reliable shot on every model
shot-locked-off.placeholder: e.g. the workshop door, nobody comes in yet

shot-extend.name: Continue the previous clip
shot-extend.desc: The only genuine continuity: the previous clip becomes an @Video reference
shot-extend.placeholder: e.g. Maya leaves frame and reaches the avenue
